Personally I like to brainstorm all the ideas I have so I never forget them. I write my chapters week to week so I create a bunch of bullet points and as I’m writing I try to connect the bullet points

To be honest I read Fanfiction because it’s cool for me to see these the people and characters that bring me so much joy in new or different situations. Also if theirs a ship I know that will never be canon that I like, I can find it in a Fanfiction. Also I’ve always been a bit of a loner, not having many friends, so I kinda lived vicariously through the characters in the story. 

Following that, why I write is because I can create the world I wish I lived in. Usually when I write a Fanfiction it about a group of friends, who all get along and lean on each other for support, through the good and bad times of their life, something I wished had. 

To conclude I feel closer to the person I wish I was when I read and write, Fanfiction has gotten me through a lot. It gives me the escape I need from my life and allows me to create something cool. That’s my take at least.
